title: Trusted boundary twin: the same descriptor-only tool on an UNVERIFIED boundary with a deny-on-unprofiled policy is refused
note: Twin of P3: no operator verification, and the operator's declared policy for profile-less tools is deny. The pair demonstrates that the verified-boundary bypass is the ONLY path around the unprofiled-tool boundary for read-classified tools — remove the operator fact and the same call is refused (rule unprofiled-tool-deny). Documented scope: the unprofiled-tool rule adjudicates heuristically READ_ONLY-classified unprofiled tools; other effect classes are owned by different rules (e.g. the unknown-profile fail-safe), which is why this twin uses a read-classified status tool.
